name: Iede Shita Ore no Musume ga Koushuu Toilet de Kami-sama o Boshuu Shiteiru Rashii!?
original_name: 家出した俺の娘が公衆トイレで神様を募集しているらしい！？
source:
Saion is a no-good office worker who likes to pay girls for sex in public bathrooms. One day he gets a call from his ex-wife -- it seems their daughter, a girl he hasn't seen in over 10 years, has run away from home.

He hasn't seen his daughter in so long that he's mostly forgotten her face... but he can't shake the feeling that the girl he recently hooked up with might be her...

"But if that's true, I had sex with my own daughter... "

Was it a chance encounter, or will he be able to see her again? It's exceedingly difficult to find her...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ158564.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
